dynamic_locations.$current_test_station: Bind to WS_COMPRESSION, WS_MEMORY or WS_DEMONSTRATION before use; station-specific safe release card required
dynamic_locations.$all_used_stations: Iterate actual used stations and verify each separately

safe_unload_variants.WS_COMPRESSION: Stop stage, controlled retraction, force-safe state, support then disconnect mounts
safe_unload_variants.WS_MEMORY: Stop/decouple input, optical off, support and controlled release of each stored pair preload, verify residual load then disconnect
safe_unload_variants.WS_DEMONSTRATION: Remove applied hand load through contact card, support paper/truss in stable carrier; do not invent a powered rig
